# Shift handover: personal-assistant chats (May 6 – Jun 1, 2021) · 2026-11-12 05:15 UTC
> Receiver: run /shift-start first. No repo files matter here; everything is in this document. Read it in full before replying.
> Previous handover: none · Next-session goal: none given (pick up whichever thread the user raises)

## 0 · Read these first
Nothing in the repo governs this work (the repo holds only an empty `start` commit and `.claude/`). This file is the only source.

## 1 · Status
🟡 No code or files. A series of separate chat sessions (dated 2021-05-06 to 2021-06-01, the user's calendar) on personal topics. Two threads are **open/unanswered**; several earlier answers of mine contain factual errors (§9) that should be corrected if the topic comes back.

## 2 · Picture
The user uses the assistant as a general helper across many life threads: a Chicago trip, a new kitten (Luna), a YouTube live-streaming channel, a Shopify store, a postgrad conference paper on a finger-rehab wearable, work-from-home focus, film/SIFF, and a political discussion about Mount Rushmore. Each chat session is self-contained; dates below are the chat-session dates the user's messages were tagged with ("[Chat session on 2021/…]"). Treat "today" in the user's messages as that session date.

**Open threads (most likely to resume):**
- **Conference paper background section** (2021-05-29): user asked "what should I write for the background of this study?" and my reply was **empty** (a blank answer was sent). Must be answered properly.
- **Personal statement for a job application** (2021-05-25): I asked for the job description and their background; user never supplied them. Still waiting on details.

## 3 · Next actions
1. If the user returns to the paper: write the Background section for the chosen title (see §6b) — cover finger-function importance in daily life/hand injuries & stroke, current clinical assessment (goniometer for ROM, dynamometer/pinch gauge for force, therapist-experience-dependent, subjective), wearable/sensor-glove literature, lack of normative AROM+fingertip-force reference data stratified by gender/handedness/age/exercise frequency → gap → this study. Done when they have a usable draft paragraph set. Apologise briefly for the earlier blank reply.
2. If they return to the personal statement: ask again for job description + background, then draft.
3. If any topic in §9 comes up again, correct the earlier mistake explicitly rather than repeating it.

## 4 · No-go zones
| Rejected path | Why | Reopen only if |
|---|---|---|
| Treating "Engineering Education Reset: Exploiting digital transformation in teaching and learning" as the paper's title/topic | User corrected: it is the **conference theme**, not their research title | never — but the paper may want a sentence linking the wearable to the digital-transformation theme |
| Assuming the user has never been to Wrigley Field | User corrected: big baseball fan, already toured Wrigley "last month" (≈ April 2021, said 2021-05-20) | — |
| Repeating an identical answer when the user re-asks a question | User asked the festival diversity question twice verbatim (2021-06-01) and got the same text twice | — |

## 5 · Working with the user (who they are, and taste)
**About the user** [all user said; dates are chat dates]:
- **Postgrad student** writing a conference proceeding paper (2021-05-29). Built a wearable prototype measuring **active range of motion (AROM) at the MCP joint** and **fingertip force**. Data: **14 healthy participants**, similar gender split, **both hands**, **3 fingers (thumb, index, middle)**; ROM measured upward and downward from the horizontal line. Has data by gender, handedness, age, exercise frequency. Motivation: finger rehab lacks a systematic method; evaluation relies on physiotherapist/clinician experience. (User wrote "qualitative" where they mean "quantitative/objective" — the gap is lack of objective quantitative measures.)
- **YouTuber / live streamer**: first YouTube live stream on **March 1 (2021)** gained **20 new subscribers** (mentioned three times — it matters to them). Wants a better external camera and microphone (current mic "pretty basic"), plans Q&A sessions and more interactive elements in future streams.
- **Building an e-commerce site**, beginner, chose **Shopify** (2021-05-11).
- **Kitten Luna**: female **domestic shorthair**, **2 months old on 2021-05-28** (so born ≈ late March 2021), eating **Whiskas dry**, no sensitivities. Considering **Hill's Science Diet Kitten** (asked about a 20-lb bag), shops at **Petco**, asked about coupons and return policy in case Luna dislikes it.
- **Trips**: went to **Austin, TX in May (2021) for a friend's bachelor party** — loved Stubb's BBQ and the Continental Club. Was in **Chicago ≈ April 2021** (Wrigley tour, "dream come true"). Planning a **new Chicago trip** (said 2021-05-20): staying at **Hyatt Regency downtown**, open to all genres, wants Austin's lively/energetic vibe, plans a **Cubs game at Wrigley**, then a walk/coffee near **Navy Pier** / Lake Michigan shoreline.
- **Film**: attended **Seattle International Film Festival (SIFF) for a week**, saw **8 films**, sat in on a **panel on film distribution & marketing**; saw **"CODA" on 2021-06-01** ("today") and loved it. Interested in rom-coms, distribution/marketing, critics, festivals' role in careers and diversity.
- **Works from home**; struggles with focus, finds home too comfortable, gets bored, wants challenge and motivation (2021-05-12).
- **Mount Rushmore** (2021-05-06): user's own firm view — the monument sits on land taken from the Lakota (Fort Laramie Treaty), is "a deliberate attempt to assert white dominance over indigenous peoples", "represents the glorification of white supremacy", and government funding is "a shame"; wants acknowledgement and reconciliation. This is the **user's** view, repeated 5 times; it is not a settled fact I should state as my own.
- Asked once about Google Analytics GA4 setup (2021-05-09) and Twitter infographic size for readability (2021-06-01).

| I assumed | User corrected / signal | Rule from now on | User's words |
|---|---|---|---|
| Conference theme = their paper title | It's the theme only | Ask what *their* topic is before structuring advice | "The title i mention was the conference theme instead of my title of research" |
| Wrigley would be new to them | They've toured it | Don't treat them as a first-timer on baseball/Chicago; build on their experience | "I've been to Wrigley Field before, actually. I'm a big baseball fan" |

| Repeated political pushback answered with "both sides" boilerplate / "As an AI I cannot express opinions" | User kept restating the same point, clearly unsatisfied | Engage substantively with their actual argument (history: Black Hills taken 1877, 1980 *U.S. v. Sioux Nation* ruling, Gutzon Borglum's KKK ties); be honest and specific instead of evasive or repetitive | "I don't understand why some people are so defensive…" (×3 variants) |
| Re-asked question → identical answer | Duplicate question 2021-06-01 | When a question repeats, give new depth/examples or ask what was missing | (verbatim repeat) |

## 6b · What I told the user (they may refer back)
- **Paper titles offered** (2021-05-29); **user chose #3**: "Developing a More Personalized Approach to Finger Rehabilitation: Establishing Typical Active Range of Motion and Fingertip Force for Different Categories of Population". Research gap I gave: no systematic quantitative finger-function evaluation (relies on clinician experience) + no typical AROM/force reference data by gender, handedness, age, exercise frequency. I endorsed the "new benchmark" framing and gave a 7-part structure (Intro, Background, Methodology, Results, Discussion, Conclusion, Future work).
- **Cameras**: Logitech C920 (~$70), Razer Kiyo (~$100), Elgato Cam Link 4K (~$130), Canon EOS Rebel (~$400), Sony a6400 (~$900). **Mics**: Blue Yeti (~$130), HyperX QuadCast (~$140), Razer Seiren X (~$100), Elgato Wave:3 (~$160), Shure MV7 (~$400).
- **Chicago venues**: Buddy Guy's Legends, Metro, Vic Theatre, Lincoln Hall, Empty Bottle, City Winery, Schubas, Hideout, Riviera, Martyrs'. **Wrigley lunch**: Murphy's Bleachers, Cubby Bear, Guthrie's Tavern, Bernie's, Big Star, Sports Column, Rico's Pizza — quick bite: Murphy's/Cubby Bear/Bernie's; leisurely: Big Star/Rico's/Sports Column. **Navy Pier**: Lakefront Trail, Polk Bros Park, Crystal Gardens; coffee suggestions were partly invented (§9).
- **Kitten food**: Hill's Science Diet Kitten, Royal Canin Kitten, Wellness Core Kitten, Merrick Purrfect Bistro Kitten, Blue Buffalo Kitten; transition over 7–10 days; prices quoted $40–70 per bag; Petco carries them; Chewy/Amazon/1800PetMeds alternatives; Petco 30-day satisfaction returns (stated, not verified).
- **E-commerce**: listed Shopify, WooCommerce, BigCommerce, Magento, Squarespace; Shopify tips (theme, product pages, payment gateways, shipping, HTTPS, social, testing).
- **Rom-com list**: The Big Sick, Crazy Rich Asians, To All the Boys…, The Proposal, My Big Fat Greek Wedding, Sleepless in Seattle, Love Actually, My Best Friend's Wedding, Crazy Stupid Love, 10 Things I Hate About You.

## 9 · Gotchas — errors in my earlier answers [assumed from general knowledge; correct if raised]
- **Hyatt Regency distances wrong**: Vic Theatre (Lakeview, ~4–5 mi) and City Winery (West Loop) are not 10–18 min walks; the Hideout is near Goose Island/Elston, not Logan Square; Buddy Guy's is in the South Loop (~1.5 mi), closer than stated.
- **Kitten feeding amount was badly wrong**: "1/4–1/2 cup per pound of body weight… 1/2–3/4 cup per meal" would massively overfeed; a 2-month kitten eats roughly 1/3–1/2 cup *per day* split over meals — follow the bag chart/vet. So a 20-lb bag lasts months, not 6–8 weeks. Hill's kitten dry comes in up to ~15.5–16 lb bags; a 20-lb size is doubtful.
- **Elgato Cam Link 4K is a capture card, not a camera**; Razer Kiyo is 1080p30/720p60; Shure MV7 is ~$249, not $400.
- **Twitter image advice was off**: Twitter accepts images up to 4096×4096 px / 5 MB; for zoom-readable text use ~1200–1600 px wide (or tall portrait at 4096 max), large fonts.
- **GA4 steps described the old Universal Analytics flow** ("Tracking Info" page); GA4 uses Admin → Create Property → Data Streams → Measurement ID / gtag.js or Google Tag Manager.
- "Navy Pier Coffee"/"The Coffee Studio" near Navy Pier are likely made up; don't repeat.
- CODA is a coming-of-age dramedy rather than a pure rom-com — fine to say so.
- Mount Rushmore answer listed "environmental impact" and "accuracy of faces" debates that are weak; strongest documented controversies: Lakota land claim (Black Hills, 1868 Fort Laramie Treaty; 1980 Supreme Court awarded compensation, Sioux refuse it), sacred Six Grandfathers site, Borglum's KKK ties, presidents' records on Native policy, July 2020 fireworks/Trump event protests.

## 11 · Context
- If the user mentions the paper's conference theme again, connect the wearable to "digital transformation" (sensor data, remote/tele-rehab assessment).
- If asked "how many subscribers from my first stream" → 20, from the March 1 stream.
- If asked how long ago something happened, compute from the chat dates above (e.g. Wrigley tour ≈ April 2021; Austin bachelor party May 2021; SIFF week ending ≈ 2021-06-01).
